content.introduction: The sources report that startup Ravel has raised $8.2M to address the spandex problem in clothing recycling, UW, Microsoft, and E8 are backing a climate tech incubator focused on data centers amid surging AI energy concerns, and Helion's funding round has grown to $500M with its Seattle office opening in pursuit of fusion energy. Additionally, Seattle voice AI startup Ultravox, formerly Fixie, was acquired by Inworld, and startup Porchlight uses AI to foster human connection in senior care. Fraxion acquired Yellow Dog Software, and there's a new No. 1 on the GeekWire 200 as AI and hardware reshape the Pacific Northwest startup index.
